overall: The AG found no violation: the Board could properly invoke litigation Purpose 3 to discuss and consent to a settlement because it indemnified the employee-defendant and so had a litigating position to protect.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board entered executive session on Sept. 17, 2014 for an improper purpose, citing litigation Purpose 3 to discuss a settlement in a suit that did not name the Board.
allegations.key_passage: Here, while the Board was not a named defendant in the pending lawsuit, it nevertheless had a litigating position to protect.
